newsitem.title: GERMANY: Summary of Ifo October German business survey.
newsitem.headline: Summary of Ifo October German business survey.

text.p: Following is a summary of key points in the IFO economic research institute's monthly business survey for October (sectors are west German unless otherwise stated, comparisons are against pvs month):
Ifo last week said its business climate index showed a rise to 97.4 in October from 95.7 in September.
Business outlook - confidence in economic growth up
Orders levels - better orders, lively demand cutting stocks
Orders level - higher demand cutting stocks, boosting hopes
Export outlook - main hope for next months
Note - In chemicals situation seen as satisfactory to good;
metals -- strong demand raising expectations; pulp and paper --
situation seen more favourable; textiles -- demand and outlook
Note - In machine-building, little change in negative
outlook; electricals -- good export prospects, order books
healthy; vehicles -- poor situation seen improving; precision
mechanical/optical sector -- still pessimistic, hoping for
export boost; steel/light metal construction -- less negative.
Business outlook - less optimistic than September
Note - Carmakers see high demand and improved orders;
electronics -- only slightly less optimistic; precision
Note - Clothing mood only slightly better; shoes -- still
Orders level - 2.7 months, still very low
Personnel plans - more companies cutting jobs
Current business - significantly worse vs September
Orders level - overstocking points to lower orders
Personnel plans - job cuts 1.5-2.0 pct seen over six months
